title: Shop email inside the Inbox
problem: Email to info@, sales@ and support@ had no place in the Inbox.
now: Inbox › Email lists the shop’s mail as conversations: read, reply, forward, add a team note or assign it.
steps: Open the email from Arman Hossain.
Press Reply all, write a line and send.
